notes: Count now: 2 (Mylo ₦7,500 / 35,000 / 75,000 per month, zero commission; Restorant free + 5% per online-paid order) — both Nigerian restaurant pickup tools (nearest_local); no Nigerian food-truck tool found. Restorant: its pickup quote is from its own guide page (the home and pricing pages don't say pickup); it also has a marketplace layer, but businesses get their own branded storefront link — BORDERLINE if Dominic sees it as a marketplace. Seen, not read: eRestaurant.ng (POS, from ₦10,000/month, no pickup focus), Dishly by OPUS (QR table ordering, ₦55,000), FoodChow Nigeria page (Indian, not mine; only named), Orda (acquired, wave 2). YUMBI (hidden price) and Catlog (no pickup) as in wave 2.
